title: UX Unification Handoff
description: Summary of a ux-unification run, passed to another skill, agent or person so context isn't lost. Compatible with the common skill-handoff fields (source_skill, target_skill, summary, key_decisions, open_questions, confidence_level, artifacts).

target_skill.description: Next skill or agent ID, or 'human'.

placement.description: Where the feature lives, e.g. 'Strategy › Rules › Rule detail › Versions tab'.

key_decisions.description: Decisions made, each ending with a tag: [GROUNDED], [INFERRED] or [SPECULATIVE].

unification_debt.description: New debt found, referencing debt.md numbers.
